segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְעוֹד אָמַר רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר: עוֹמֵד אָדָם עַל הַמּוּקְצֶה
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And Rabbi Eliezer further stated» the following leniency: «A person may stand over» objects in «storage,» such as produce that he has for some reason previously set aside from use,

segments.he: עֶרֶב שַׁבָּת בַּשְּׁבִיעִית, וְאוֹמֵר: מִכָּאן אֲנִי אוֹכֵל לְמָחָר. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: עַד שֶׁיִּרְשׁוֹם וְיֹאמַר מִכָּאן וְעַד כָּאן.
segments.en: «on Shabbat eve during the Sabbatical Year,» during which no tithes are separated, which means one may take fruit on the following day without the need for any corrective measure, «and say: From here,» from these fruits, «I will eat tomorrow. And the Rabbis say:» He may not eat «unless he marks» the pile of fruit the day before «and» explicitly «says: From here to there» I will take.
